title: Rethinking Learning in a Changing World
summary: Exploring podcast learning science, adaptability and human-centred EdTech, with lightning talks, pizza, and a lively audience discussion with the speakers.

speaker1.name: John Helmer
speaker1.talkTitle: ​What We Get Wrong About Podcasts and Learning
speaker1.description: Audio-first learning suits some learning outcomes better than others. What the evidence says, and what it means for learning design.

speaker2.name: ​Stuart Chadwick
speaker2.talkTitle: ​Learn. Adapt. Amplify: Why Adaptability Is the Ultimate Competitive Advantage
speaker2.description: Learn. Adapt. Amplify. The future isn't a technology challenge, it's an adaptability challenge, learn how to stay ahead.

speaker3.name: ​Emily Maltby and James Maltby
speaker3.description: In this talk, we’ll share our design journey so far, from initial ideas and prototyping through testing and go-to-market strategy. We’ll reflect on what we’ve learnt along the way, discuss the challenges of bringing an EdTech idea to life, and share our aspirations for the future of Skills Tally.
